figurative_meaning_en: The team or side defeated in a game
example_sentences_in_bangla: ফুটবল ম্যাচে আমাদের দল হারকাত হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Our team ended up as the হারকাত in the football match.
They fell to the losing side in the debate.
note: Commonly used in informal sports discussions in Bengali culture
